title: Trust Region Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2607.04751v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Big goals are hard to achieve all at once; breaking them into small steps is wiser. We present Trust Region Policy Distillation (TOP-D), which transforms the notoriously unstable, high-variance On-Policy Distillation (OPD) into a stable training paradigm by dynamically constructing a proximal teacher. Theoretically, we establish a rigorous framework demonstrating that TOP-D inherently controls gradient variance. By providing a formal global convergence analysis alongside a monotonic improvement bound, we mathematically formalize the reliability and stability of the overall training dynamics. Empirically, TOP-D dramatically enhances training stability, sample efficiency, and final performance on mathematical reasoning tasks. More importantly, TOP-D introduces zero additional computational overhead, positioning itself as a promising alternative to the well-established OPD paradigm.

translated_abstract: 宏大的目标很难一步实现，将其分解为小步骤是更明智的做法。我们提出了置信域策略蒸馏（TOP-D），该方法通过动态构建一个近端教师模型，将出了名的不稳定、高方差的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）转变为一种稳定的训练范式。在理论上，我们建立了一个严格的框架，证明TOP-D天然地能够控制梯度方差。通过提供正式的全局收敛分析以及单调改进界，我们在数学上形式化了整体训练动态的可靠性与稳定性。在实证方面，TOP-D在数学推理任务上显著提升了训练稳定性、样本效率和最终性能。更重要的是，TOP-D没有引入任何额外的计算开销，使其成为成熟的OPD范式的有前景的替代方案。
tldr: TOP-D通过动态构建近端教师模型，将不稳定、高方差的在线策略蒸馏转化为稳定且高样本效率的训练范式，在理论上保证了梯度方差控制与全局收敛性，且不引入任何额外计算开销。
en_tdlr: TOP-D transforms the unstable, high-variance On-Policy Distillation into a stable training paradigm by dynamically constructing a proximal teacher, achieving dramatically improved stability, sample efficiency, and performance with zero additional computational overhead, backed by formal global convergence guarantees.
